title: Wallabag preview can be driven to arbitrary server-side URLs

evidence.quote: Wallabag URL must start with http:// or https://

reasoning: The same API surface lets an API-authenticated caller store any http(s) Wallabag URL and then make the backend connect to it during preview. There is no host allowlist, private-address guard, explicit opt-in for private hosts, or stronger admin-only authorization visible on this route. In deployments where API tokens are used by clients rather than only a fully trusted admin, this is an SSRF path to internal services.
reproduction: Use the Wallabag config update route to set url to an internal http(s) endpoint, then POST /wallabag/preview; the backend will attempt the Wallabag token/fetch flow against that configured host.
recommendation: Centralize Wallabag URL validation before persistence or before outbound requests. Reject loopback, link-local, RFC1918, and metadata IP ranges by default, or require an explicit trusted/private-host setting plus admin-only authorization for changing and previewing these URLs.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the test search did not find direct /wallabag/preview coverage or URL rejection cases.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an API test that stores a private or loopback Wallabag URL and asserts POST /wallabag/preview rejects it without invoking the outbound Wallabag client, plus a positive case for an allowed public/explicitly trusted host.
minimumFixScope: app/api/config.py URL validation and, preferably, a shared outbound URL safety helper used by WallabagService callers.
